outcome: body composition (body fat, visceral adipose tissue, lean mass, fat-free mass)
insulin resistance (Homeostatic Model Assessment for Insulin Resistance)
insulin secretion (Homeostatic Model Assessment of b-cell index, Insulin Secretion-Sensitivity Index-2)
cohort: The study included 171 women with prior gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) from the MySweetheart trial.
finding: Longer breastfeeding duration among women with prior GDM was associated with lower insulin resistance, weight, weight retention, body fat, and inflammation, but not lower bone density at 1 year postpartum.
